pattern: たら最後 / たが最後（たらさいご / たがさいご）
aliases: たらさいご / たがさいご
purpose: Warn that once an action occurs, a bad consequence is inevitable.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
Vたら + 最後; Vた + が最後
Once you tell that secret, the whole town will know.
Once I sit in this chair, I inevitably fall asleep.
Once he starts that story, it will not end for an hour.
formation: Vたら + 最後; Vた + が最後
restrictions: Typically introduces an irreversible or hard-to-stop consequence.
mistake: 最後 is not the last occurrence in a sequence here.
